notes:
Recent context: mid-market SaaS (B2B) building a knowledge-centric product search layer for product docs + support articles. Team is product-led; adoption driven by self-serve and integrated search bundles for customers. Interested in Redwood because: explicit focus on production economics and rerank endpoints.

Meeting highlights (shorthand):
- 2024-11-21 intro call (Jordan/Leah + CTO Matt). CTO: 'we need consistent latency at scale — cannot trade too much quality for speed'.
- 2024-11-28 demo: hosted API quickstart + sample rerank flow. Seemed promising.
- 2024-12-01 kickoff: agreed POC scope (2-week hosted API rerank test using Crestwood eval set). Fireflies: ff_20241201_crestwood_kickoff.

Technical requirements / notes:
- Primary workload: top-k reranking of retrieval candidates for doc search and support routing.
- QPS expected during peak: 200-500 queries/sec (multi-tenant across customers).
- Latency SLO (90p): <= 120ms end-to-end for rerank (prefer target ~80ms for 10-item rerank).
- Throughput: batched offline scoring for nightly re-rank of 10M records (preferred ability to run offline scoring via batch job APIs).
- Offline scoring: integration with existing Spark pipeline; will export scores nightly and compare MRR uplift.
- Evaluation: provided evalset v3 (drive link). Aim: +8-12% MRR vs current heuristic ranker. Need tooling to run offline evals and compare model variants.
- Model preference: open models preferred (cost conscious); willing to test a 7B-13B reranker and a cheaper 2-4B fallback for low-tier customers.
- Fallbacks: request automatic fallback routing to cheaper model under load.

Security / compliance:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + enterprise audit logs. SOC2 report required for procurement. Data residency for EU customers is a requirement for some accounts — will need residency guarantees for subset of customers. KMS integration desired for key management.

Commercial signals:
- Starting POC on hosted API to prove quality and latency. If POC meets SLOs and MRR targets, move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and pricing.
- Price sensitivity: mid-market budget; expected ARR ask ~$50-150k depending on committed capacity and support SLA.

Quotes and client sentiment:
- CTO Matt: 'If we can show a measurable MRR bump with stable latency we can justify reserved capacity.'
- Head of Product: 'need a straightforward way to run offline evals and re-run with different prompt/feature configs'.

POC scope / acceptance criteria:
- 2-week hosted API POC: integrate rerank endpoint, run A/B on 50k queries, compute MRR and latency distribution.
- Acceptance: MRR uplift >= 8% OR latency 90p <= 120ms while maintaining >= 95% availability.

Next steps (short):
- Jordan to share POC onboarding checklist and sample code (done 2024-12-02).
- Leah to provide architecture review and Dedicated capacity draft pricing by 2024-12-15.
- Product team to clean eval labels (action: Crestwood data team).
- Legal to review data residency addendum (waiting on SOC2 evidence).

Other tidbits:
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching/quant recommendations) — cost savings pitch will help conversion.
- Would like a short technical session with runtime engineer to discuss KV-cache behavior for rerank flows.

Summary: warm mid-market opportunity. Likely path: Hosted API POC -> Dedicated if acceptance criteria met. Main risks: SOC2/legal timeline and budget sign-off.
